## File: folder_paths.yaml
## Type: settings manifest
## Purpose: Canonical folder path mapping used by the Default Folder Paths
## settings menu. Maps settings keys to labels and capability metadata.

id: "prismata.universe.config.folder-paths"
udi: "prismata.universe.config.folder-paths"
schema_version: "1.0.0"
version: "1.0.0"
description: >
  Canonical folder path keys used by Universe's Default Folder Paths settings menu.
  Each entry maps a settings key (stored in settings.paths) to its menu label and
  the capability that resolves it (app-settings-paths).

paths:
  - key: "canonical_folder"
    label: "Canonical Folder"
    description: "Root folder for canonical registry schemas and manifests."
    capability: "prismata.universe.capability.app-settings-paths"
    pick_mode: "folder"

  - key: "project_root"
    label: "Project Root"
    description: "Root folder for the active Prismata project."
    capability: "prismata.universe.capability.app-settings-paths"
    pick_mode: "folder"

  - key: "workspace_root"
    label: "Workspace Root"
    description: "Universe workspace directory (state, ingestion, registry, archive)."
    capability: "prismata.universe.capability.app-settings-paths"
    pick_mode: "folder"

  - key: "temp_folder"
    label: "Temp Folder"
    description: "Temporary working directory for intermediate outputs."
    capability: "prismata.universe.capability.app-settings-paths"
    pick_mode: "folder"
